title: reflog 救援：reset --hard / 删分支后找回丢失的提交
expected_output:
=== 正常历史 ===
  main -> 2ea4292(chore: init) -> 09f157f(feat: add cart) -> f14d21c(feat: add checkout)
  可见提交数: 3

=== 误操作：git reset --hard HEAD~2 ===
  reset 后 main=2ea4292(chore: init)
  git log 可见提交数: 1  <- 看起来 c2/c3 消失了
  但对象仍在库中（未被 GC），因为它们还被 reflog 指向

=== 救援：git reflog ===
  HEAD@{0}: reset: moving to 2ea4292         f14d21c -> 2ea4292
  HEAD@{1}: commit: feat: add checkout       09f157f -> f14d21c
  HEAD@{2}: commit: feat: add cart           2ea4292 -> 09f157f
  HEAD@{3}: commit: chore: init              None -> 2ea4292
  找到丢失的 tip: f14d21c(feat: add checkout)

=== git reset --hard f14d21c ===
  main=f14d21c(feat: add checkout)
  可见提交数: 3
  c2/c3 均已找回: True

=== 同类场景：误删分支 ===
  git branch -D feature 删除的提交: 09f157f(feat: add cart)
  reflog 里仍有该分支的记录: True
  找回方式: git branch feature 09f157f（同理适用于 commit --amend / rebase 丢失的提交）

注意: reflog 只存在于**本地** .git/logs/，不会 push 给远端，也不能跨机器使用
code:
import sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

"""reflog = 仓库里所有 ref（HEAD/分支）变更的 append-only 流水，默认保留 90 天。
只要误操作的提交还被 reflog 里的某条记录指向，它就还在对象库里 —— 这就是『后悔药』。"""
import zlib


def short(tag):
    return "%07x" % (zlib.crc32(tag.encode("utf-8")) & 0xFFFFFFF)


class Repo:
    def __init__(self):
        self.parents, self.msg, self.refs = {}, {}, {}
        self.reflog = []          # 每次 ref 移动追加一条

    def commit(self, msg, parents=()):
        cid = short(msg + "#" + ",".join(parents))
        self.parents[cid] = list(parents)
        self.msg[cid] = msg
        self._move("HEAD", self.refs.get("main"), cid, "commit: " + msg)
        self.refs["main"] = cid
        return cid

    def _move(self, ref, old, new, action):
        self.reflog.append({"ref": ref, "from": old, "to": new, "action": action})

    def ancestors(self, start):
        seen, stack = set(), [start]
        while stack:
            n = stack.pop()
            if n in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(n)
            stack.extend(self.parents.get(n, []))
        return seen

    def log(self, head):
        return sorted(self.ancestors(head), key=lambda c: len(self.ancestors(c)))

    def hard_reset(self, target):
        old = self.refs["main"]
        self._move("HEAD", old, target, "reset: moving to " + target)
        self.refs["main"] = target
        return old

    def branch_delete(self, name):
        old = self.refs.pop(name)
        self._move(name, old, None, "branch: deleted")
        return old


r = Repo()
c1 = r.commit("chore: init")
c2 = r.commit("feat: add cart", [c1])
c3 = r.commit("feat: add checkout", [c2])
print("=== 正常历史 ===")
print("  main -> " + " -> ".join("%s(%s)" % (x, r.msg[x]) for x in r.log(r.refs["main"])))
print("  可见提交数: %d" % len(r.log(r.refs["main"])))
print()

lost = r.hard_reset(c1)
print("=== 误操作：git reset --hard HEAD~2 ===")
print("  reset 后 main=%s(%s)" % (r.refs["main"], r.msg[r.refs["main"]]))
print("  git log 可见提交数: %d  <- 看起来 c2/c3 消失了" % len(r.log(r.refs["main"])))
print("  但对象仍在库中（未被 GC），因为它们还被 reflog 指向")
print()

print("=== 救援：git reflog ===")
for i, e in enumerate(reversed(r.reflog)):
    print("  HEAD@{%d}: %-32s %s -> %s" % (i, e["action"], e["from"], e["to"]))
lost_tip = None
for e in reversed(r.reflog):
    if e["action"].startswith("reset") and e["from"]:
        lost_tip = e["from"]
        break
print("  找到丢失的 tip: %s(%s)" % (lost_tip, r.msg[lost_tip]))
print()

recovered = r.hard_reset(lost_tip)
print("=== git reset --hard %s ===" % lost_tip)
print("  main=%s(%s)" % (r.refs["main"], r.msg[r.refs["main"]]))
print("  可见提交数: %d" % len(r.log(r.refs["main"])))
print("  c2/c3 均已找回: %s" % all(x in r.ancestors(r.refs["main"]) for x in (c2, c3)))
print()

print("=== 同类场景：误删分支 ===")
r.refs["feature"] = c2
deleted = r.branch_delete("feature")
print("  git branch -D feature 删除的提交: %s(%s)" % (deleted, r.msg[deleted]))
hit = [e for e in r.reflog if e["ref"] == "feature" and e["to"] is None]
print("  reflog 里仍有该分支的记录: %s" % bool(hit))
print("  找回方式: git branch feature %s（同理适用于 commit --amend / rebase 丢失的提交）" % deleted)
print()
print("注意: reflog 只存在于**本地** .git/logs/，不会 push 给远端，也不能跨机器使用")
